data: In the bottom left plot, what is the value of the red line at the WE training size of 10^5?

The red line represents the bpele4 segmentation method. The bottom left plot corresponds to the ZH (isolating) language. At the WE training size of 10^5, the red line (bpele4) appears to be around 30 on the y-axis. Therefore, the value of the red line at the WE training size of 10^5 is approximately 30.
